name: Oyako Samba
original_name: 母娘サンバ —オヤコサンバ
source:
A chaste wife and precocious daughter... participating in a notoriously difficult carnival... can they withstand it...?

The conflict and reality of a man's beloved family... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081433.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
贞洁的妻子和早熟的女儿……参加一场出了名的艰难的狂欢……他们能承受得住吗……？

一个男人心爱的家庭的冲突和现实…… 

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081433.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
